reasons: The rule is a 'missing' kind and the finding asserts no insurance provision exists anywhere in the agreement; IBM is a hosting vendor operating the e-business Hosting Environment and holding Customer Components/Customer Data, squarely the vendor profile the rule targets, so an insert is warranted.

The inserted paragraph tracks the playbook model language closely (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' comp as required by law, certificates on request, term plus one year) and correctly names IBM as the insuring party.

Placement is appropriate — appended in the miscellaneous/risk-of-loss area — and the original paragraph p0192 is left untouched, so this is an additive edit with no collateral damage to existing terms.
The comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice, carries the [Playbook] prefix, states what changed and why, and offers the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback as a negotiating concession.
All deterministic checks pass; no over-flagging risk since there is no existing clause sitting at the fallback.
